## Findings
- claim-1: \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) has the Schur basis indexed by partitions in the \(r\times(n-r)\) box. [source-2@L1318-L1324|claim=formal-document]
- claim-2: Conditional on the stipulated box/Schur/Pieri presentation, \(i,j\ge2\), \(q=i+p\), \(r=j+c\), and \(\min(p,c)=1\), the degree enumeration is \[ J_d=\mathbb Zx_0,\quad J_{d+1}=\mathbb Z\{x_1,y_1\},\quad J_{d+2}=\mathbb Z\{\gamma,x_2,z,y_2,\theta\}, \] omitting \(\gamma\) for \(p=1\) and \(\theta\) for \(c=1\). Moreover \[ A_1=\langle h_1\rangle,\quad A_2=\langle h_2,h_1^2\rangle,\quad A_3=\langle h_3,h_2h_1,h_1^3\rangle, \] and, writing \(r_2=h_2x_1,r_3=h_2y_1,r_4=h_1\gamma,r_5=h_1x_2,r_6=h_1z,r_7=h_1y_2,r_8=h_1\theta\), \[ h_2h_1x_0=r_2+r_3,\quad h_1^3x_0=r_4+r_5+2r_6+r_7+r_8, \] \[ h_1^2x_1=r_4+r_5+r_6,\qquad h_1^2y_1=r_6+r_7+r_8. \]
- claim-3: The supplied material does not define “the fifteen cases in (4),” their column orders, or their intended \(R_{\mathrm{full}}\); therefore fifteen literal products \(\mathcal C R_{\mathrm{selected}}=R_{\mathrm{full}}\) cannot be specified without inventing data.
## Strategy
Use the stipulated box/Schur/Pieri presentation to derive the degree-\(\le d+2\) slots and the four row dependencies. Verify
\[
[h_2,h_1^2]=[s_{(2)},s_{(1,1)}]
\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix},
\quad
[h_3,h_2h_1,h_1^3]=[s_{(3)},s_{(2,1)},s_{(1,1,1)}]
\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1\\0&1&2\\0&0&1\end{pmatrix},
\]
whose determinants are \(1\). Thus the stated descriptions of \(A_1,A_2,A_3\) follow integrally.

## Gaps
The exact table/equation “(4)” is absent: its fifteen case conditions, column orders, selected-row conventions, and matrices \(R_{\mathrm{full}}\) are not supplied. Hence the fifteen matrices \(R_{\mathrm{selected}}\), integral coefficient matrices \(\mathcal C\), and literal products
\[
\mathcal C R_{\mathrm{selected}}=R_{\mathrm{full}}
\]
are underdetermined. Supplying them would require inventing data. Therefore the requested exhaustiveness certificate is not established from the present record.

## Next
Provide the exact missing equation/table (4), including all fifteen cases and matrix conventions. Then derive each selected matrix from Pieri coordinates and display the corresponding integral products entrywise.
